clauses.text: Purpose: Cited knowledge/docs answers from the Stellar research corpus ($vectorSearch over Voyage embeddings; BM25-lite keyword fallback when vectors are unavailable).
Use when: SDF organizational questions (enterprise fund, mandate, leadership, structure)
Use when: 'how does X work', 'is X possible / has X been discussed on Stellar', 'what does the SEP/spec/audit say about X'
Use when: primary-source citations for a thesis or design question; ecosystem KNOWLEDGE & explainer questions ('what is / how does / who / why / is it true that…')

Use when: security & risk (audits, exploits, incidents, post-mortems, oracle manipulation), bug-bounty / disclosure program status (source=security-program: which program is current, HackerOne vs Immunefi, where to report), compliance & regulation (Travel Rule, FATF, KYC/AML, sanctions)

Use when: SDF's canonical organizational pages (source=sdf-org): mandate incl. self-funded/pays-taxes structure, terms of service / Delaware non-profit legal form, foundation mission, leadership & board roster, Enterprise Fund scope & portfolio size, quarterly-reports index

Use when: funding & governance (SCF v7.0, award tiers, Neural Quorum Governance) and SCF program mechanics — how to apply step-by-step, Build/Instawards/Liquidity/Public-Goods awards, eligibility, review timeline (prescreen, panel review, community vote, KYC), deadlines
Use when: SDF org/mission/legal structure; protocol history (SCP whitepaper, authors); ecosystem programs (ambassadors, regional chapters, bootcamps)
Use when: Soroban security incidents (reentrancy, sdk advisories/CVEs, DoS); ecosystem history (Protocol 20 mainnet launch, XLM initial supply, UNHCR aid, Enterprise Fund)

Use when: making an issued asset tradable/visible on exchanges, wallets, explorers, aggregators; contract source verification (release.yml, Stellar Lab vs stellar.expert); fact-checking a claim about Stellar
Example question: What is the SDF enterprise fund and what is its mandate?
Example question: How does the Stellar Consensus Protocol work?
Example question: What does the SCF Handbook say about award tiers?
Example question: Has there been a reentrancy incident on Soroban?
Example question: How do I apply for an SCF Build Award?
Example question: How do I make my issued asset visible on exchanges and explorers?
Description: Vector search over the Stellar research corpus.
Description: Semantic search over the Stellar knowledge corpus — SDF blog, SCF Handbook, SEPs/standards, dev docs, papers, audits, incident reports.

Description: Returns cited text chunks with source, section, URL, confidence, and provenance dates (publishedAt = the source's own stated date; observedAt = when ingest last crawled the page; audits add auditor/severity — filterable; report-level enumeration → listAudits).
Description: THE surface for 'how does X work', 'what does the SEP/spec/audit say', and how-to/feasibility questions.
Description: Not for products and their funding/status → use searchProjects.
Description: Catalog note: this is the broad Scout cited-research recovery lane for history, standards, incidents, audits, and unknown technical topics.
Description: Treat chunks as leads: preserve their source and date, and require an exact entity match before attribution.
Workflow: Ecosystem people/events: Who participated, built, won, or showed up in a hackathon or ecosystem event?
Workflow: Evidence-poor open-world recovery: Who or what is an obscure Stellar entity, what is its history, or what should I do when narrow lookups return empty or only adjacent candidates?
Not for: what products exist or their funding/status -> searchProjects
Not for: GitHub source code ranked by quality -> searchRepos
